name: Warcraft Reborn Shaman weapon imbues wire their extra-attack and heal procs (#8854)
contract: Report: none of a Reborn Shaman's weapon imbues proc; the enchant appears to apply, but the temporary
enchantment proc never goes off. rev_20261022_86_coa_windfury_custom_proc already fixed Reborn Windfury
Weapon rank 1's enchant trigger (spell 1133757), but SpellItemEnchantment 10284 (cloned from stock 284,
the enchant Reborn Windfury Weapon rank 2, spell 1108235, applies) triggers spell 1133758 instead, which
had no spell_script_names/spell_proc row: Spell::EffectEnchantItemTmp still applies the temporary enchant
(matching 'appears to apply'), but Player::CastItemCombatSpell's ITEM_ENCHANTMENT_TYPE_COMBAT_SPELL path
casts a SPELL_AURA_DUMMY aura that sSpellMgr->GetSpellProcEntry never recognizes, so spell_sha_windfury_weapon
never runs and the extra attack never fires. Reborn Earthliving Weapon's only rank (spell 1151730, enchant
103345 cloned from stock 3345) triggers spell 1151940 the same way, also missing both rows.
rev_20261028_03_coa_reborn_shaman_weapon_imbue_procs clones stock Windfury's own trigger (33757) for
1133758, and stock Earthliving's twin-keyed proc (-51940) for 1151940, exactly as rev_20261022_86 and
rev_20261008_27_coa_reborn_shaman_spells.sql cloned their own Reborn Shaman trigger spells. Before the fix
log path never fires because the spell itself exists; the aura is simply never recognized as proccable),
so the server cannot even describe their proc chance; after the fix each entry's effective Chance falls
back to the triggered spell's own Spell.dbc ProcChance (20 for 1133758, 100 for 1151940), an expectation
derived from Spell.dbc/SpellItemEnchantment.dbc independently of this fix's SQL values.

steps.label: SETUP: the weapon has no temp enchant yet
Windfury Weapon rank 2 enchants the weapon with SpellItemEnchantment 10284
DISCRIMINATING: the extra-attack trigger (1133758) that enchant 10284 casts on hit is a recognized proc
SETUP: the weapon has no temp enchant yet
Earthliving Weapon enchants the weapon with SpellItemEnchantment 103345
DISCRIMINATING: the heal trigger (1151940) that enchant 103345 casts on hit is a recognized proc
